mnemonic.meaning: "WAS IT, OH (わざと)... on purpose?" Yes. He tripped you deliberately.

examples.ja: 彼はわざと負けた。
examples.en: He lost on purpose.

items.note: Often negative: done on purpose to annoy. わざわざ is going out of your way to help.

mnemonic.meaning: The king supports (支) his people and distributes (配) everything to them, so he decides everything. Rule, control.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, HIGH (しはい)!" The queen rules from her high throne.

examples.ja: 王が国を支配していた。
examples.en: The king ruled the country.

items.note: 支配人 = manager (of a hotel, shop).

mnemonic.meaning: "ARRA, YOU RULE (あらゆる) over all of it!" The genie gives you every possible kingdom.

examples.ja: あらゆる方法を試した。
examples.en: I tried every possible method.

items.note: Only before a noun. Stronger than すべての.

mnemonic.meaning: You view (観) and inspect (察) the ants for hours. Observation, watching closely.
mnemonic.reading: CAN SAT, SUE (かんさつ): Sue sat by the can all day, observing the ant inside.

examples.ja: 子供たちは虫を観察した。
examples.en: The children observed the insects.

items.note: For careful, scientific watching: 観察日記 (observation diary).

mnemonic.meaning: KEY, TSUI (きつい): your key gets stuck in a tight lock. Tough job, harsh day.

examples.ja: この靴は少しきつい。
examples.en: These shoes are a little tight.

items.note: Also for hard work and sharp words: 仕事がきつい, きつい言い方.

mnemonic.meaning: 袋 has 衣 (clothes) at the bottom: cloth sewn into a bag.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, CROW (ふくろ): a crow steals your bag of chips.

examples.ja: 袋はいりますか。
examples.en: Do you need a bag?

items.note: Used with 〜袋 as ぶくろ: 紙袋 (paper bag), 手袋 (gloves).

mnemonic.meaning: 偶 is chance, and 々 repeats it: chance, chance. You just happened to be there.
mnemonic.reading: TOMATO, TOMATO (たまたま): by chance two tomatoes fall on your head.

examples.ja: 駅で偶々友達に会った。
examples.en: I happened to meet a friend at the station.

items.note: Usually written in kana: たまたま.

mnemonic.meaning: 続 is continue: what continues after the cliffhanger. The sequel, the rest.
mnemonic.reading: TSU-ZOO-KEY (つづき): you need the zoo key to see the rest of the story.

examples.ja: 話の続きは明日にしよう。
examples.en: Let's leave the rest of the story for tomorrow.

items.note: Noun from 続く. 続きを読む = read on.

mnemonic.meaning: 騒 has 馬 (horse): horses stampeding through town. A commotion, an uproar.
mnemonic.reading: SAW, WAGGY (さわぎ): the waggy dog sees a saw and starts a huge fuss.

examples.ja: 外で何か騒ぎが起きている。
examples.en: Something's causing a commotion outside.

items.note: 騒ぐ = to make noise. 大騒ぎ = a big fuss.

mnemonic.meaning: The next (次) rank (第) depends on how you do now. Depending on, as soon as.
mnemonic.reading: SHE DIE (しだい)? Depending on the doctor, she'll be fine.

examples.ja: 天気次第で予定を決めます。
examples.en: We'll decide the plan depending on the weather.

items.note: Noun + 次第 = depends on. V-stem + 次第 = as soon as: 着き次第 (as soon as I arrive).

mnemonic.meaning: Your arrogant (慢) self (自) shows off. Boasting, pride.
mnemonic.reading: GEE, MAN (じまん)! He won't stop boasting about his car.

examples.ja: 彼はいつも車を自慢している。
examples.en: He's always showing off his car.

items.note: Easy to mix up with 我慢 (がまん, endurance). 自慢の〜 = someone's pride and joy.

mnemonic.meaning: BOOTS, KEH, RUE (ぶつける): you throw your boots at the wall and bump your hand. Ouch.

examples.ja: 机に足をぶつけた。
examples.en: I banged my leg on the desk.

items.note: Also 気持ちをぶつける = to vent your feelings at someone.

mnemonic.meaning: The pattern (範) of what's surrounded (囲) by the fence: the range, the scope.
mnemonic.reading: HONEY (はんい): the bee's range covers every flower within a mile.

examples.ja: テストの範囲を教えてください。
examples.en: Please tell us what the test covers.

items.note: 範囲内 = within range. 試験範囲 = material covered on an exam.

mnemonic.meaning: 鉄 has 金 (metal) on the left: the most common metal. Iron.
mnemonic.reading: TETSU (てつ) as in 地下鉄: the subway runs on iron rails. TEH-TSU, steel.

examples.ja: 鉄は熱いうちに打て。
examples.en: Strike while the iron is hot.

items.note: 鉄道 (railway), 地下鉄 (subway).

mnemonic.meaning: The main (主) thing you stretch (張) your voice for. A claim, an assertion.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE CHOW (しゅちょう): he insists the shoe is food. A strange claim.

examples.ja: 彼は自分の意見を強く主張した。
examples.en: He strongly asserted his opinion.

items.note: Stating your view firmly. 自己主張 = asserting yourself.

mnemonic.meaning: Hold (持ち) and raise up (上げる). To lift. Lift someone up with words: to flatter.
mnemonic.reading: MOCHI, AH, GAY RUE (もちあげる): you lift a giant mochi over your head.

examples.ja: この箱は重くて持ち上げられない。
examples.en: This box is too heavy to lift.

items.note: Figuratively "to butter someone up".

mnemonic.meaning: 蹴 has 足 (foot) on the left: the foot kicks.
mnemonic.reading: KAY, RUE (ける)! Kay kicks the ball, and the goalie rues it.

examples.ja: ボールを強く蹴った。
examples.en: I kicked the ball hard.

items.note: Also "to reject": 提案を蹴る (turn down a proposal). Godan despite ending in -eru.

mnemonic.meaning: The machine's (機) ability (能). What it does: its function, feature.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, NO (きのう): this key has no function. Same sound as 昨日 (yesterday).

examples.ja: この携帯にはいろいろな機能がある。
examples.en: This phone has all sorts of features.

items.note: Same reading as 昨日 (yesterday). Context makes it clear.

mnemonic.meaning: Things (物) that live (生き). Living things, creatures.
mnemonic.reading: EEK, KEY, MONO (いきもの)! A creature crawls out of the keyhole.

examples.ja: 海にはたくさんの生き物がいる。
examples.en: There are many creatures in the sea.

items.note: Covers animals, insects, even plants loosely. 動物 is just animals.

mnemonic.meaning: The condition (状) at present (現). The present situation, status quo.
mnemonic.reading: GEN JOE (げんじょう) looks at the mess and says: that's the situation right now.

examples.ja: 現状を変えるのは難しい。
examples.en: It's hard to change the current situation.

items.note: Formal. 現状維持 = keeping the status quo.

mnemonic.meaning: 命 is order (like 命令): you give an order. To command.
mnemonic.reading: MAY GEE RUE (めいじる): "May, gee, I command you to clean up!"

examples.ja: 社長は部下に調査を命じた。
examples.en: The president ordered his staff to investigate.

items.note: Formal. Everyday is 命令する or 言いつける. Also 命ずる.

mnemonic.meaning: SHAH, BELL (しゃべる): the Shah rings his bell and won't stop chatting. Talk, talk, talk.

examples.ja: 授業中にしゃべるな。
examples.en: Don't chatter in class.

items.note: Casual, often "talk a lot". Formal speaking is 話す.

mnemonic.meaning: "ACHOO! COUGH! CHEE (あちこち)!" sneezes all over the place, here and there.

examples.ja: 鍵をあちこち探した。
examples.en: I searched all over for my keys.

items.note: Same as あちらこちら, more casual.

mnemonic.meaning: 掻 has 扌 (hand): your hand scratches an itch.
mnemonic.reading: CACKLE (かく) as you scratch your mosquito bite. Same sound as 書く: you scratch with a pen, too.

examples.ja: 蚊に刺されたところを掻いた。
examples.en: I scratched my mosquito bite.

items.note: Also in idioms: 汗をかく (to sweat), 恥をかく (to be embarrassed). Usually in kana.

mnemonic.meaning: 徐 means slowly, and 々 repeats it: slowly, slowly. Gradually.
mnemonic.reading: JOJO (じょじょに) climbs the stairs little by little, one step at a time.

examples.ja: 病気は徐々に良くなっている。
examples.en: The illness is gradually getting better.

items.note: Slightly formal. だんだん and 少しずつ are everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: The most (最) middle (中): right in the middle of it. In the midst.
mnemonic.reading: SIGH, CHEW (さいちゅう): you're in the middle of chewing when the phone rings.

examples.ja: 食事の最中に電話が鳴った。
examples.en: The phone rang in the middle of dinner.

items.note: Grammar 〜の最中に is on the cheat sheet. Read もなか, it's a sweet.

mnemonic.meaning: Tie up (結) the argument (論). The conclusion, the verdict.
mnemonic.reading: KET-SU-RON (けつろん): Ketchup? Ron concludes it's the best sauce.

examples.ja: まだ結論は出ていない。
examples.en: No conclusion has been reached yet.

items.note: 結論から言うと = to get to the point.

mnemonic.meaning: A substitute (代) who expresses (表) the group's view. A representative, delegate.
mnemonic.reading: DIE, HYO (だいひょう): the representative says he'd die for the team.

examples.ja: 彼女はクラスの代表に選ばれた。
examples.en: She was chosen as the class representative.

items.note: 日本代表 = the Japanese national team. 代表的 = typical.

mnemonic.meaning: "HOT, TOE (ほっと)!" You pull your foot out of the hot water. Phew, relieved.

examples.ja: 試験が終わってほっとした。
examples.en: I was relieved the exam was over.

items.note: Usually ほっとする. Different from ホット (hot).

mnemonic.meaning: 狂 has 犭 (beast) + 王 (king): a king who acts like a wild beast. To go mad.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, RUE (くるう): your cue stick is off, the shot goes wrong, and you go mad.

examples.ja: 時計が狂っている。
examples.en: The clock is off.

items.note: For people and machines: 予定が狂う (plans go wrong).
